Menu templates

Fifteen designs for a restaurant's digital menu. Every one uses the same menu data, works in Portuguese and English, and is built for phones: the sections and categories stay pinned at the top, and tapping a category jumps to it. Tap a design to try it with the Sweet & Salt menu.

With photos

No photos

For restaurants without food photos. These use the logo, or the restaurant's initials when there is no logo, and colour and shapes instead of pictures.

All fifteen read templates/menu.json, so changing that file updates every design.
